messages:
ellie: Quick question — I used the corp card at SFO for parking + EV charger yesterday. The statement shows one auth 'SFO AUTO' for $73. Receipt PDF has two line items: 'Terminal A EV CHARGER $45' and 'Parking Lot B $28'. How should I submit this? cc @finance
marcus: @ellie can you upload the PDF to Expensify and tag your manager? If merchant names differ we usually need a short note explaining both items. :+1:
ellie: Uploaded the PDF now: `SFO_2026-03-20_receipt.pdf`. It has the two lines but the corpcard feed collapsed them under SFO AUTO. Manager approval ok?
shilpa: @ellie approved for work travel. Please add a note in Expensify that this was airport EV charging + parking and I'll approve in the app.
finance-bot: Policy reminder: when merchant feed aggregates multiple items under a single descriptor, attach the itemized receipt and manager note. Transactions < $75 combined are typically auto-approved with manager sign-off.
devin: Thanks @shilpa @ellie — for reconciliation we'll tag the $45 to "ground-transport:energy" and $28 to "ground-transport:parking". If the receipt filename could include the card last4 that helps (e.g., `receipt_1234.pdf`). No tip recorded?
ellie: No tip. Edited the expense note to state "EV charger $45 + airport parking $28 (work travel)" and renamed file to `receipt_1234.pdf`. Tagging @shilpa for approval in Expensify.
shilpa: Approved in Expensify. @devin you can mark for reconciliation and close. Thanks everyone! :tada:
